sub_answers.sub_question: What disputes arose over representation of Bosnia's ethnic groups within the national team and football association?
sub_answers.text: Football in Bosnia and Herzegovina divided along ethnic lines during the war, with Bosnian Croats forming the Football Federation of Herzeg-Bosnia in 1993 which included only Croat clubs [d55965203s4p0].
